process_area.title: Periodic Examination, DOLE Compliance & Disease Surveillance

value_stream.name: Occupational Health, Safety Clinic & Employee Wellness

fields.Participants: OH Nurse, HR, Company Physician, HMO

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-test of "test, lab work" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "OH Nurse/Physician reviews results" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "HR clears hire for onboarding or rescinds offer per" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-479 (ensure controlled execution — Periodic Examination, DOLE Compliance & Disease Surveillance (PA-83.2).)
- operational: accredited-clinic SLA and batched scheduling
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hiring risk**: Late or incomplete PEM delays onboarding; mitigated by accredited-clinic SLA and batched scheduling
System Touchpoints: - Pre-employment exam workflow; fitness-to-work determination; medical record archive

steps.activity: HR refers conditional hire for pre-employment medical exam (physical, chest X-ray, drug test, lab work) at accredited clinic
OH Nurse/Physician reviews results; determines fitness-to-work for specific role (lifting requirements, hazmat handling, driving)
HR clears hire for onboarding or rescinds offer per medical findings (subject to anti-discrimination law); archives record confidentially

fields.Trigger: Annual APE cycle (employee anniversary or fiscal cycle)

workflows.name: Annual / Periodic Medical Examination (APE) Program Execution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-schedule of "schedule by location" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Employee completes APE" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Company Physician reviews APE" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-479 (ensure controlled execution — Periodic Examination, DOLE Compliance & Disease Surveillance (PA-83.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Coverage risk**: Incomplete APE misses early disease; mitigated by tracked completion and reminders
System Touchpoints: - APE scheduling; clinic results integration; occupational health record system
Time Estimate: - 1 day per employee; weeks of program execution

steps.activity: OH Nurse Manager plans annual APE schedule by location; contracts accredited clinic; communicates schedule and requirements to employees
Employee completes APE (physical, lab, ECG for >40, chest X-ray); clinic transmits results to occupational health record system
Company Physician reviews APE; flags health risks; refers for follow-up; recommends workplace accommodation if needed

fields.Participants: Company Physician, OH Nurse, HSE, HR
fields.Trigger: Annual cycle or hazard exposure change
fields.Volume: Exposed roles: paint mixers, lumber yard, hazmat handlers, drivers, noise-exposed

workflows.name: DOLE-Required Periodic Exam by Hazard Category (Chemical/Physical/Biological)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-schedule of "schedules and tracks hazard-specific exams" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Company Physician reviews results" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-479 (ensure controlled execution — Periodic Examination, DOLE Compliance & Disease Surveillance (PA-83.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Missed hazard-specific exam violates DOLE; mitigated by exposure-role register and tracking
System Touchpoints: - Hazard-exposure register; exam scheduling; occupational health record

steps.activity: HSE/Company Physician identifies hazard-exposed roles per DOLE D.O. 198-18; defines role-specific periodic exam (audiometry for noise, spirometry for chemical, vision for drivers)
OH Nurse schedules and tracks hazard-specific exams; ensures completion for all exposed employees
Company Physician reviews results; recommends exposure reduction, PPE upgrade, or job transfer for abnormal findings

workflows.name: Vaccine & Immunization Program (Flu, Hep-B, Tetanus, COVID)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records in immunization registry" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks adverse events" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-479 (ensure controlled execution — Periodic Examination, DOLE Compliance & Disease Surveillance (PA-83.2).)
- operational: on-site clinics and coverage tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Health risk**: Low coverage enables outbreak; mitigated by on-site clinics and coverage tracking
System Touchpoints: - Immunization registry; cold-chain monitoring; adverse-event reporting

steps.activity: OH Nurse Manager designs immunization program per role risk: Hep-B for first-aiders/handlers, tetanus for construction/yard, flu for customer-facing, COVID per DOH guidance
OH Nurse administers vaccines (or coordinates with LGU/HMO); records in immunization registry; manages cold-chain
OH Nurse reports immunization coverage to DOH where required; tracks adverse events; updates registry

fields.Participants: OH Nurse, HSE, HR, Store/DC Manager, DOH

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitors absence patterns, reported illness, and clinic visits for cluster…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow notification of "contact tracing, isolation support, sanitation intensification,…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks outbreak resolution and lessons" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-479 (ensure controlled execution — Periodic Examination, DOLE Compliance & Disease Surveillance (PA-83.2).)
- operational: surveillance dashboard and rapid response
Pain Points / Risks: - **Health risk**: Late detection causes widespread infection; mitigated by surveillance dashboard and rapid response
System Touchpoints: - Absence/clinic surveillance dashboard; outbreak response playbook; DOH reporting

steps.activity: OH Nurse monitors absence patterns, reported illness, and clinic visits for cluster detection at store/DC level
OH Nurse Manager activates outbreak response: case investigation, contact tracing, isolation support, sanitation intensification, vaccination/treatment
HR/Communications notifies affected employees and coordinates with DOH/LGU for reporting; tracks outbreak resolution and lessons

fields.Trigger: New workstation, injury trend, or periodic review
fields.Volume: Lifting roles (receiving, lumber yard), cashiers, office

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-schedule of "Store/DC Manager implements controls" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks MSD injury trend" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-479 (ensure controlled execution — Periodic Examination, DOLE Compliance & Disease Surveillance (PA-83.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Injury risk**: Poor ergonomics cause chronic MSD; mitigated by assessment and engineering/administrative controls
System Touchpoints: - Ergonomic assessment records; injury-trend analytics; control tracker

steps.activity: HSE conducts ergonomic assessment of high-risk workstations (lifting, repetitive, prolonged standing); recommends adjustments
Store/DC Manager implements controls: lifting aids, anti-fatigue mats, adjustable stations, rotation schedules
OH Nurse tracks MSD injury trend; evaluates control effectiveness; recommends program adjustments

workflows.name: DOLE Annual Medical Report (AMR) & OHS Statistics Compilation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compiles annual occupational health statistics" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-inspect of "OH Nurse Manager submits DOLE Annual Medical Report per" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: integrated data and pre-submission validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Incomplete/inaccurate AMR; mitigated by integrated data and pre-submission validation
System Touchpoints: - Occupational health/OHS statistics; AMR template; DOLE submission

steps.activity: OH Nurse compiles annual occupational health statistics: medical exams, immunizations, injuries/illnesses, lost-time, work-relatedness
HSE compiles OHS incident data (frequency, severity, near-miss); aligns with medical statistics for integrated AMR
OH Nurse Manager submits DOLE Annual Medical Report per establishment; archives supporting data for inspection

fields.Volume: High-exposure zones (lumber yard, paint, DC machinery)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measure noise, air quality, chemical exposure in identified zones per OHS…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reports exposure-trend to management" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-479 (ensure controlled execution — Periodic Examination, DOLE Compliance & Disease Surveillance (PA-83.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Health/compliance risk**: Unmeasured exposure harms workers; mitigated by accredited annual monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Exposure-monitoring records; PEL comparison; OHS analytics

steps.activity: HSE contracts DOH/DOLE-accredited lab to measure noise, air quality, chemical exposure in identified zones per OHS standard
HSE compares results to Permissible Exposure Limits (PEL); implements controls if exceeded (ventilation, PPE, enclosure)
OH Nurse links exposure data to hazard-specific periodic exam results; reports exposure-trend to management
